$description: What a hotel can change on top of a template (sites.brand). Everything else is derived and checked; see docs/11-design-contract.md.
text: hex colour, optional (must stay readable on the background)
contrastGates: text on background: ink on paper >= 4.5:1
text on cards: ink on surface >= 4.5:1
text on alternate sections: ink on tint >= 4.5:1
secondary text on background: muted on paper >= 4.5:1
secondary text on cards: muted on surface >= 4.5:1
secondary text on alternate sections: muted on tint >= 4.5:1
accent text on background: accentText on paper >= 4.5:1
accent text on alternate sections: accentText on tint >= 4.5:1
button text on accent: accentInk on accent >= 4.5:1
footer secondary text: inverseMuted on inverse >= 4.5:1
keyboard focus ring: focus on paper >= 3:1
